Gather my goods and pay for them!

Yummy snacks? Funny snacks?[XENO:n ]
Best snacks in village right here!

Pollen treats at dirt cheap prices![XENO:n ]
But friends no worry! Treats not dirty!

Night-time snacks! Night-time snacks![XENO:n ]

All reviews of my snacks be lies![XENO:n ]

Can't believe it could come to that.

Thought Daboll was better than that.[XENO:n ]
So disappointed.

Need to give myself[XENO:n ]
a sound scolding.

What become of village[XENO:n ]
